# Gofer Content

> Gofer Content builds, hosts, and maintains websites for artists, makers, and small businesses in St. Petersburg, Florida. Every site is hand-coded from scratch, live in 24-72 hours, and set up to be found on Google and in AI answers.

## Services
- Website builds: Hand-coded sites, no templates or drag-and-drop builders
- Hosting and upkeep: Updates, forms, and security handled monthly
- Getting found: Search and AI answer setup so customers find the business
- Landing pages: Single-page sites built fast

## Main page
- [Gofer Content](https://gofercontent.com/): Services, client work, and contact form
